en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Ali<sup>asws</sup> was asked about
a fish with its belly being slit, so a fish was found inside it. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Eat both of them together’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was asked about
fish inside which another fish is found. He (the Imam) said, ‘You can use both of them for food.’”
